name: prompt-pad-sender
description: Ctrl+Enter in prompts.txt sends the prompt block under the cursor (between - and ;) to the terminal and marks it sent; Ctrl+Shift+Enter does the same but first discards whatever is already in Claude's input box; @ completes project files, ~ completes sentences of Claude's last answer.

commands.title: Prompt Pad: Send prompt block to terminal
Prompt Pad: Clear the input box, then send the prompt block

promptPad.terminalName.description: Send to the terminal whose name contains this text; empty sends to the active terminal.

promptPad.submitDelayMs.description: Milliseconds between pasting the prompt and pressing Enter.
